hero.heading: XMLens Foundation Shell
hero.description: A zero-install, MIT-licensed static workbench for inspecting, validating, querying, transforming, and visualizing XML documents.
openDecisions.heading: Milestone M0 Status & Architecture Contract
openDecisions.intro: This workspace boots the M0 static shell on Vite + strict TypeScript with bilingual EN/JA catalogs and strict CSP.
openDecisions.item1: Local-first execution: all parsing and visualization run client-side without external network requests.
openDecisions.item2: Bilingual parity: every UI string is loaded from locales/en.json and locales/ja.json.
openDecisions.item3: Accessibility target: WCAG 2.2 AA landmarks, keyboard navigation, and light/dark/high-contrast themes.
openDecisions.item4: Optional XSLT 2.0/3.0 plugin remains off by default and excluded from the workspace repository.
